questions.topic: Page 5: 1.3 THE 2-D CARTESIAN COORDINATE SYSTEM (Pages 5-6 Focus)
questions.questionText: Referring to Fig 1.3 on page 5, if $D_1R_1$ represents the door, explain how you would determine its width based on the coordinates provided on the x-axis.

subjective_evaluation_points.point: Identifies the x-coordinates of the endpoints of the door $D_1$ and $R_1$.
States the method of finding the difference between the x-coordinates.
Calculates the width correctly using the coordinate values (e.g., $11.5 - 7 = 4.5$ units).
Relates the coordinate distance to the actual scale of the room.

questions.explanationAnswer: To find the width of the door $D_1R_1$, we subtract the x-coordinate of $D_1$ from the x-coordinate of $R_1$. Given $D_1$ is at $x=7$ and $R_1$ is at $x=11.5$, the width is $11.5 - 7 = 4.5$ units.
questions.explanationQuestion: This question requires interpreting the provided diagram (Fig 1.3) and applying coordinate geometry to find a length.
questions.correctAnswer: The width is found by calculating the difference between the x-coordinates of the endpoints, which is $11.5 - 7 = 4.5$ units.
